Hazard Statements: H319 Causes serious eye irritation.
Precautionary Statements: P280 Wear protective gloves/eye protection/face protection.
P305+P351+P338 IF IN EYES: Rinse cautiously with water for several minutes.
Remove contact lenses if present and easy to do. Continue rinsing.
P337+P313 If eye irritation persists: Get medical advice/attention.
Keep out of reach of children.
Store in a well-ventilated place.
Do not eat, drink or smoke when using this product.
Avoid breathing vapours or spray mist.
Use only in well-ventilated areas.
Wash hands thoroughly after handling.
If swallowed: Call a POISON CENTRE or doctor/physician if you feel unwell.
In case of skin contact: Wash with plenty of soap and water.
In case of eye contact: Rinse cautiously with water for several minutes.
Remove contact lenses if present and easy to do. Continue rinsing.
If eye irritation persists: Get medical advice/attention.
If on skin: Wash with plenty of soap and water.
If inhaled: Remove person to fresh air and keep comfortable for breathing.
If medical advice is needed, have product container or label at hand.
Dispose of contents/container in accordance with local regulations.
Keep away from heat/sparks/open flames/hot surfaces. No smoking.
Keep container tightly closed.
Protect from sunlight. Do not expose to temperatures exceeding 50°C.
Do not pierce or burn, even after use.
Keep away from incompatible materials.
Do not allow to enter drains or water courses.
For professional use only.
This product is not suitable for use on interior walls or ceilings.
Not for use on timber or other porous substrates unless specifically recommended.
Apply to clean, dry, sound, non-dusty surface.
Surface preparation: Clean surface thoroughly before application.
Remove all loose material, dirt, grease, oil, wax, and old paint.
Sand down any rough areas or previous paint layers.
Prime porous or absorbent surfaces with appropriate primer.
Application method: Use brush, roller, or spray.
Recommended dilution: Do not dilute unless specified.
Coverage: up to 15m² per litre.
Drying time: Touch dry: 30 minutes. Recoat: 2 hours.
Clean tools with water immediately after use.
Storage: Store in a cool, dry place. Keep container tightly closed.
Shelf life: 2 years from date of manufacture if stored correctly.
